library.name: JMCMotorControl
library.author: LAGARI A <lagariscience@gmail.com>
library.sentence: ACCESS RESTRICTED (company use only) - contact lagariscience@gmail.com for access. Complete UDP command system for JMC integrated servo/stepper drives (Modbus-RTU / RS-485) on Controllino.
library.paragraph: This library is now restricted to company use and is no longer distributed publicly; contact lagariscience@gmail.com to request access. Hardened Modbus-RTU transport (CRC-verified responses, exception detection, retries, real timeouts), unit-correct motor control (position, velocity, homing, zero/position redefinition), a non-blocking status monitor that pushes limit-switch, fault and online/offline events over UDP, and the full JMC_CONTROLLINO_V3 command set (P, PA, S, SD, B, L, BS, Z, ZO, ZS, R, I, X plus V/VA/VS/HV/H extensions). Verified against the JMC Modbus-RTU manual V2.2 and the IHSS60-R/RC datasheet. Not affiliated with JMC (Shenzhen Just Motion Control).

library.name: Waveshare_TFT_Touch
library.author: Tedd OKANO
library.sentence: Arduino driver for the Waveshare 2.8inch TFT Touch Shield (SKU: 10684; ST7789V LCD + XPT2046 touch)
library.paragraph: Provides ST7789V graphics primitives and XPT2046 resistive touch reading over the shield's shared hardware SPI bus. Pin mapping is fixed by the shield's own PCB (D3/D4/D7/D9/D10, Arduino Uno R3 header form factor) so no wiring configuration is needed.
